preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
For each test case, the number of elements N must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= B[i] <= i + 1 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element B[i] in the sequence must be between 1 and i+1 for valid indices.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(B[i] == i + 1 for i in range(N)) or all(B[i] == i + 1 for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: If any element B[i] is equal to i+1, it is possible to obtain the sequence; otherwise, it is not.
